The floor is covered with a checkered pattern of light and dark tiles, adding to the grandeur of the setting. In the foreground, two individuals are engaged in a dance. On the left, a man dressed in a classic black tuxedo with a white shirt and black bow tie is holding hands with a woman on the right.
